windows.60: Over the past 60 days, visitors have noted issues with the food quality, particularly mentioning bland flavors and limited menu options. Some found the pricing to be high relative to portion size, and there were complaints about the lack of complimentary water cups. Service and wait times were also mentioned in several reviews, indicating room for improvement in those areas. Overall, the average rating was 4.25 based on eight reviews, with two expressing notable dissatisfaction.
windows.90: Over the last 90 days, visitors have raised concerns primarily about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several reviews mention limited menu options, inconsistent food quality, and high prices that do not match portion sizes or taste. Service issues include long wait times and periods when orders could not be taken due to kitchen delays. While some healthy food choices are noted, many guests found certain dishes bland or poorly prepared. These issues have contributed to an average rating of 3.5 across 18 reviews.
